resharper_max_lambda_and_anonymous_function_parameters_on_line #

The cap on a lambda's parameters per line. Inert: measured at 120 and at 60 columns on a parenthesized lambda and a delegate(…), both values return identical output, while csharp_max_formal_parameters_on_line in the same batch chops the lambda's list. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified unreachable / inert. Confirmed at 10000, 2 and 1 on two fixtures — a five-parameter parenthesized lambda beside a four-parameter delegate(…), and a shorter pair whose baseline agrees. ⚠ The int probe's degeneracy is not the cause here: 2 and 1 are meaningful caps for a five-parameter list, and the oracle chops neither.

resharper_wrap_after_lambda_and_anonymous_function_declaration_lpar #

Whether a lambda's first parameter gets a line of its own. ⚠ Probed rather than reasoned about: eleven fixtures under this repository's own .editorconfig, one cleanupcode invocation per configuration, each fixture first shown to move under the key that really governs its construct.
